Marshall & Dominguez LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 281-555-1704
Settlement Demand
September 26, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1236 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing on behalf of our client, Richard Smith, regarding the motor vehicle collision that occurred on February 23,
2024. Our client was traveling in the right-hand lane when the insured vehicle changed lanes without adequate
clearance and sideswiped the driver's side of our client's car. The force of the impact pushed our client's vehicle
against the guardrail and caused significant damage to the driver's door, quarter panel, and mirror.
Our client was taken from the scene and subsequently diagnosed with cervical and lumbar strain. The physicians who
treated our client documented restricted range of motion in the neck, persistent muscle spasm in the lower back, and
headaches that have interfered with work and daily activities. Physical therapy is ongoing, and our client's treating
doctors anticipate several more months of care.
Liability in this matter is clear. The insured driver failed to check blind spots and yield before changing lanes, which is
a plain violation of the applicable traffic statute. Responsibility for the resulting harm rests with your insured.
On behalf of our client, we demand payment of $32,000.00 to resolve all bodily injury and property damage claims
arising from this collision. This demand will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive
a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Katherine Moore, accident reconstructionist
Sincerely,
Kyle Sanders
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
